scripts.release:mac: if pgrep -f 'Villain Layer[.]app/Contents/MacOS/villain-layer' >/dev/null; then echo 'Villain Layer is running. Quit it first — replacing the bundle under a running app kills it, and takes its agents with it.'; exit 1; fi; tauri build --bundles app && rm -rf '/Applications/Villain Layer.app' && ditto 'src-tauri/target/release/bundle/macos/Villain Layer.app' '/Applications/Villain Layer.app'
